title: Ómada Family Sports Club
subtitle: Bright, memphis-inspired landing for a family sports club in Puebla. Hero video, memberships, class schedule, and real-time Instagram feed.
about:
What is Ómada?

A family sports club in Puebla with pool, tennis courts, soccer fields, gym, kids area and a café. The site had to feel as vibrant as the brand, give families the full picture of what the club offers, and move inquiries from Instagram DMs into a real contact flow.

gallery.title: Landing page
gallery.description: Full landing: hero with aerial video of the club, disciplinas, spaces, instructors, membership plans, class schedule, map, and live Facebook + Instagram feeds.

challenge.title: The problem: a club with no front door online
challenge.description: The club had Instagram and word of mouth, but no site to send prospects to. Every inquiry turned into a slow DM back-and-forth with no context.

cards.title: Nothing to point referrals at
cards.description: A family hearing about Ómada had no way to see the facilities, class schedule or membership options before showing up.

cards.title: Instagram as a help desk
cards.description: Membership questions, class times, and prices all funneled into DMs. Slow for the family, slow for the staff.

cards.title: A brand that needed room to breathe
cards.description: Ómada's identity is loud and playful — primary blues, pinks, yellows, bold display type. The site had to match it without turning into a mess.

solution.title: The solution: a bold, single-page club site
solution.description: One scrolling page covering everything a family needs before signing up: disciplines, spaces, instructors, memberships, class schedule, location, and a direct contact form.

features.title: Facility tour by section
features.description: Each discipline (natación, fútbol, tenis, fitness) and each space (pool, courts, gym, kids area, café) gets its own card with photos.

features.title: Three membership plans
features.description: Individual ($1,200), Familiar ($2,800), Juvenil ($800). Benefits listed per tier with a Familiar plan marked as 'más popular'.

features.title: Class schedule table
features.description: Weekly schedule across all disciplines, plus a downloadable PDF for families to keep handy.

features.title: Live social feeds + contact
features.description: Embedded Facebook and Instagram feeds for freshness, map + direction, and a form that lands straight in the staff's inbox.

techStack.title: How it's built
techStack.description: Next.js + Tailwind on Vercel. Static where possible, with social embeds for the live content.

categories.name: Frontend
categories.description: Next.js with Tailwind for the memphis-style layout. Custom color palette and bold display type baked into the design tokens.

categories.name: Hosting
categories.description: Deployed on Vercel with image optimization through next/image.

categories.name: Social & maps
categories.description: Embedded Facebook and Instagram feeds for freshness, Google Maps for the club location.

results.title: A real front door for the club
results.description: Referrals, press, and ad traffic now land on a page that shows the club instead of a social profile.

results.title: Fewer DMs, better leads
results.description: Membership inquiries come through the form with the context the staff needs to reply fast.

results.title: Brand in context
results.description: The site lives up to Ómada's identity — bold, playful, unmistakable — without compromising on readability or mobile UX.
